get.summary: Live voice assistant over WebSocket (session only; Origin must match the app). Binary frames: raw PCM, 16-bit LE mono (client -> server 16 kHz, server -> client 24 kHz). Text frames: JSON VoiceServerMessage / VoiceClientMessage
get.description: Upgrade to WebSocket. Server text frames: `ready`, `state` (listening|thinking|speaking), `interrupted`, `tool`, `transcript`, `error` (code). Client text frame: `{"type":"audio_end"}`. 503 `voice_unavailable` when GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured, 429 `too_many_sessions` over the per-user limit.
